# Reused PICA backend

Independent copy of Eyes of Gold's custom 3DS backend and the rendering
interface/combiner it was tested against. Original source hashes and provenance
are recorded in provenance.json. No ROM, game models, textures or audio are
included here. These files do not depend on the GoldenEye project directory.

This is a renderer compilation baseline, not a Perfect Dark engine port.
Perfect Dark's interpreter interface still needs comparison/adaptation once
its source checkout is available. Compiled objects alone do not boot a level.
